title: Indian Cardamom Rice Pudding with Pistachios
summary: A creamy Indian-style rice pudding scented with cardamom and finished with crunchy pistachios. It is naturally gluten-free and makes a comforting dessert served warm or chilled.
steps: Put the rinsed rice, milk and salt in a heavy-based saucepan. Bring to a gentle simmer over medium heat, stirring often so the milk does not catch on the bottom.
Reduce the heat to low and cook for 30–35 minutes, stirring frequently, until the rice is very tender and the pudding is thick and creamy.
Stir in the sugar, cardamom and vanilla extract. Cook for another 3–5 minutes, stirring, until the sugar has dissolved and the pudding looks glossy.
Spoon into bowls and scatter over the chopped pistachios. Serve warm, or chill until cold for a thicker pudding.
